title: State Technical University Annual Exam Registration
raw_notice_text:
STATE TECHNICAL UNIVERSITY EXAM CONTROLLER BOARD
EXAMINATION NOTICE 2024/SEM-ODD/102
Issue Date: 01 October 2024

IMPORTANT NOTICE: Applications accepted till: 20th October 2024

SUBJECT: REGISTRATION FOR WINTER END-SEMESTER EXAMINATIONS

All Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) 3rd, 5th, and 7th semester students are instructed to fill the examination enrollment form on the university ERP portal.

ELIGIBILITY:
Students with minimum 75% aggregate class attendance and no pending semester fee dues.

EXAM SCHEDULE & TIMELINE TABLE:
- Form submission commencement: 05th October 2024
- Portal Closing Date: 25th October 2024 (Revised)
- Late fee window: 26th to 28th October 2024 (Rs. 500 extra)

EXAMINATION FEES:
Standard examination fee of Rs. 1,200 payable online through university gateway.

REQUIRED DOCUMENTS:
Previous semester original grade card scan and department clearance certificate.

HELP DESK CONTACT:
examcontroller@stu-univ.ac.in | Phone: 0120-4592000
